webmcpPackagesPageSubtitle.message: Manage WebMCP packages from every source in one place: built into the extension, installed from a registry, and authored by you or your agent. Enable a package to expose its tools on matching pages.

webmcpPackagesPageNote.message: Sources are derived, not declared: builtin-webmcp → built-in; webmcp with an install record → registry; webmcp without one → mine. All packages use manifest.json, config.json and workflow files. The built-in mount is read-only, the writable mount lives at vfs://external/webmcp/. Registry-installed packages do not reappear under “My packages”.
